objective: Improve crown and occlusal decoder geometry while preserving the frozen base decoder in cervical and root proxy bands.

evidenceBasis.expertFinding: The current base reconstructs roots more reliably than molar and premolar crown, cusp, ridge and occlusal anatomy.

evidenceBasis.decision: Retain ground-truth crown supervision, replace sparse-logit-only root protection with explicit decoded-output teacher consistency, and reject post-hoc mesh grafting as the primary route.
